```sql
SELECT
    c.id AS cliente_id,
    c.nome AS cliente_nome,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.importo), 0) AS totale_ordini,
    COALESCE(COUNT(o.id), 0) AS numero_ordini

    ordini o ON c.id = o.cliente_id
